name: com.nomadgames.analytics.AppStartedEmitter
comment: APP_STARTED call site (ANLT-01): JVM application ready — not per guest mint (avoids flood).

name: com.nomadgames.analytics.EventSink
comment: Thin ANLT-01 sink: structured JSON log + append-only analytics_events (D-107). Never rethrows into caller TX (T-07-26).

methods.name: emit
methods.comment: Fire-and-forget emit. playerId is UUID only — never passwords or tokens in attrs.

methods.name: listCatalog
methods.comment: JWT player catalog with owned/equipped flags; guests allowed (D-51).

methods.name: purchase
methods.comment: Soft-currency purchase: lock wallet → funds check → soft_purchases → ledger debit → inventory (D-58, D-59). Idempotent on client key; never writes purchases IAP table (D-60). Ignores any client balance/coinsDelta (ECON-04).

methods.name: equip
methods.comment: Equip an owned SKU into its slot (D-55, D-56). Never leaves an empty slot — free defaults remain equippable; switching is equip-another. Unowned SKUs rejected (T-04-18).

methods.name: getLoadout
methods.comment: Seven-slot map slot→skuId for presentation (D-56).

methods.name: grantMatchRewards
methods.comment: Sync match grant inside the caller's settle TX (D-45). Unique idempotency_key → re-read prior. Uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so Postgres does not abort the settle transaction (D-58).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.EquipRequest
comment: Equip intent. Slot/skuId validated server-side against inventory (D-55, T-04-18).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.EquipResult
comment: Confirmed loadout write for one slot.

name: com.nomadgames.economy.MatchRewardCommand
comment: Plain command for match reward grants — owned by economy (session must not leak types here).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.MatchRewardTable
comment: Server-side match reward table (ECON-01). Win > loss > 0; GEMS scarce and win-only. humanMatch=true covers PRIVATE and CASUAL PvP seats (same COINS/GEMS column).

methods.name: gems
methods.comment: Win-only; +1 GEMS when hash(matchId, playerId) % 100 < p.

name: com.nomadgames.economy.PurchaseRequest
comment: Soft-currency buy body. Extra client fields (coins/balance/coinsDelta) are ignored (ECON-04).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.PurchaseResult
comment: Soft purchase outcome: refreshed wallet + owned flag (ECON-02 / ECON-05).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.RewardGrant
comment: Coins/gems granted for one seat on one match (overlay + ledger).

name: com.nomadgames.economy.ShopCatalog
comment: Flat shop catalog projection (client groups by slot).

methods.name: equipSlot
methods.comment: Upsert loadout slot (equip-another; never leaves an empty slot — D-55).

methods.name: insertIfAbsent
methods.comment: Insert soft purchase; returns false when idempotency_key OR (player_id, sku_id) already exists (CR-01 / D-59 — ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING covers both uniques).

methods.name: lockBalance
methods.comment: Row-lock wallet balance before soft-purchase debit (D-59 / T-04-12).

methods.name: creditIfAbsent
methods.signature: creditIfAbsent(java.util.UUID, java.lang.String, long, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.UUID)
methods.comment: Append ledger row and credit wallet. Locks the wallet row (FOR UPDATE) then applies a relative balance update so concurrent soft debit / match grant cannot lose updates (CR-02 / D-58). Returns empty if idempotency_key already exists (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).

name: com.nomadgames.games.alchiki.internal.ScriptedBot
comment: Deterministic noisy ThrowInput per difficulty (RESEARCH A3, D-21, D-22). leftover ids are mixed into the RNG so the bot cannot "see" pocketed bones.

name: com.nomadgames.games.stickpull.StickPullBot
comment: Scripted Stick Pull bot tap delays with human-like jitter (BOT-02).

methods.name: nextDelayMs
methods.comment: Next delay until the following tap (ms). Includes occasional long pauses for EASY.

methods.name: schedule
methods.comment: Build a delay schedule of {@code tapCount} taps for unit tests / diagnostics.

name: com.nomadgames.games.stickpull.StickPullConstants
comment: Yolo numeric locks for Stick Pull (D-88…D-91 / RESEARCH).

name: com.nomadgames.games.stickpull.StickPullRuntime
comment: Heap-only Stick Pull live sessions: countdown, bot taps, 20 Hz tick, 10 Hz StickState.

methods.name: setClientPaused
methods.comment: Bot-mode client Pause: freeze tug clock + bot taps until Resume (WR-01). No-op for human PvP sessions.

name: com.nomadgames.games.stickpull.StickPullSim
comment: Authoritative 1D stamina tug. Ignores client timestamps/force (D-91). Local/near (host/player) pulls toward −1; far (joiner/bot) toward +1.

methods.name: pauseClock
methods.comment: Freeze absolute tug deadline across reconnect grace (UI-SPEC / Phase 3 mirror). Idempotent while already paused.

methods.name: resumeClock
methods.comment: Restore tug deadline from remaining time after last seat clears.

methods.name: applyAcceptedTap
methods.comment: Attempt to accept a tap at server {@code now}. Pre-GO: Casual ignores (D-90); Ranked 1st false start → stamina 0.70, 2nd → rated forfeit (D-100).

methods.name: tick
methods.comment: Idle regen + clock settle. Call at sim tick while LIVE.

name: com.nomadgames.identity.AdoptHint
comment: Server hint for Flutter replaceGuest sheet when login includes guestPlayerId (D-93).

methods.name: login
methods.signature: login(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.UUID, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String)
methods.comment: Bound sign-in with D-93 adopt contract (AUTH-03). Never sums wallets onto a non-empty target. When {@code guestPlayerId} is present, caller must prove guest session possession (CR-01).

methods.name: logout
methods.comment: Revoke bound refresh rows and mint a fresh guest session (AUTH-04 / BindIT logoutMintsGuest).

methods.name: isImportEligible
methods.comment: Empty-target import: matches==0 AND ledger/soft spend==0 (D-93).

methods.name: copyGuestProgressOntoBound
methods.comment: One-time overwrite of wallets + cosmetics from guest onto empty bound — never sum.

methods.name: abandonGuestEconomy
methods.comment: After adopt=import copy: zero guest wallets and clear inventory/loadout in the same TX so dual-spend cannot continue on the abandoned guest device row (WR-01 / D-93).

methods.name: bind
methods.comment: Bind username+password to the same guest playerId (AUTH-02 / D-93). Never merges wallets.

methods.name: bind
methods.comment: AUTH-02: bind requires authenticated guest JWT (not permitAll).

methods.name: login
methods.comment: AUTH-03: username/password login is permitAll (rate-limited). Adopt requires guest possession.

methods.name: logout
methods.comment: AUTH-04: revoke refresh for caller; return freshly minted guest session.

name: com.nomadgames.identity.LoginRequest
comment: Bound login body. When {@code guestPlayerId} is set, possession must be proven via {@code Authorization: Bearer} guest access and/or {@code guestRefreshToken}.

methods.name: requireGuestPossession
methods.comment: Prove control of {@code guestPlayerId}: valid guest access JWT (sub match) or a live refresh row for that player. Used by login adopt (CR-01 / ASVS L1).

name: com.nomadgames.identity.internal.LoginRateLimiter
comment: Per-IP login attempt window (T-07-09 credential stuffing).

methods.name: reset
methods.comment: Clears in-process FIFO — ITs call this so leftover SEARCHING peers do not leak.

name: com.nomadgames.matchmaking.GameDiscriminator
comment: Server allowlist for rooms.game and casual enqueue (T-06-03).

methods.name: requireBound
methods.comment: D-97 / T-07-12: guests cannot enqueue Ranked.

name: com.nomadgames.matchmaking.RankedQueueService
comment: Sibling FIFO Ranked queue (D-97, D-98). Never shares CasualQueue maps; never bot-fills.

methods.name: reset
methods.comment: Clears in-process FIFO — ITs call this so leftover SEARCHING peers do not leak.

methods.name: requireBoundPlayer
methods.comment: D-97 / WR-04: fail-closed Ranked gate — DB isGuest=false, not JWT claim alone.

methods.name: join
methods.comment: POST /v1/rooms/join

methods.name: reset
methods.comment: Clears all windows — used by ITs so flood cases do not poison later tests.

methods.name: recordSettlement
methods.comment: Sync XP/W/L/soft Elo inside the caller's settle TX (D-75). Idempotent on (matchId, playerId). Elo only when mode is CASUAL and both seats are present.

methods.name: levelForXp
methods.comment: Level 1 at 0 XP; cumulative threshold to enter level n+1 is 100*n*(n+1)/2.

methods.name: thresholdForLevel
methods.comment: XP required to reach the given level (level 1 → 0).

name: com.nomadgames.profile.SoftElo
comment: Classic Elo for soft casual MMR (D-75). K=24, floor 100; Ranked/Glicko stays Phase 7.

methods.name: lockPlayer
methods.comment: Lock profile columns for settle (FOR UPDATE).

methods.name: claimSettlement
methods.comment: Returns true if this is the first settle for (match, player).

name: com.nomadgames.rating.BoardsController
comment: GET /v1/boards — bound-only skill boards (LEAD-01…03 / T-07-21).

methods.name: requireBound
methods.comment: Guests cannot read boards (D-96 / T-07-21).

name: com.nomadgames.rating.BoardsService
comment: Bound-only skill boards Top-100 (LEAD-01…03 / D-105, D-106). Never orders by coins/gems.

name: com.nomadgames.rating.RatingService
comment: Ranked-only Glicko settle (D-104). SoftElo stays in ProfileService for CASUAL. Cosmetics are never consulted. all_time_peak updates on higher settle (D-105).

methods.name: recordRankedSettlement
methods.comment: Idempotent Glicko update for a Ranked match. Expects exactly two seats with WIN/LOSS/DRAW.

methods.name: currentSeasonKey
methods.comment: @deprecated prefer {@link SeasonService#currentSeasonKey()} — kept for call-site clarity in tests.

name: com.nomadgames.rating.SeasonService
comment: Quarterly soft season keys + ensure-on-read reset (D-105). Formula: r' = round(1500 + 0.5*(r-1500)); RD' = min(350, RD + 0.5*(350-RD)); σ unchanged.

methods.name: ensureCurrentSeason
methods.comment: Ensure every player+game with prior-season rows has a soft-reset row for the current quarter.

methods.name: loadOrCreateSeasonRow
methods.comment: Load current-season row or soft-reset from the latest prior season (defaults if none).

name: com.nomadgames.rating.internal.Glicko2
comment: Vendored Glicko-2 (D-104 / STACK). One Ranked settle = one rating period with m=1 opponent. Defaults: r=1500, RD=350, σ=0.06, τ=0.5. No Maven Glicko JAR.

methods.name: startPrivate
methods.comment: NORMAL six target bone ids plus saka-host and saka-joiner identifiers. Client does not pick turn order (D-30, D-31); two-body spawn is later.

methods.name: applyTap
methods.comment: Seat-bound Stick Pull tap. Server re-timestamps with Instant.now() (D-91, T-06-01).

methods.name: setStickPullClientPaused
methods.comment: Bot Stick Pull Pause/Resume — freezes tug clock and bot taps while the human menus.

methods.name: isHumanPvP
methods.comment: Human two-seat PvP: private rooms, casual Quick Match, and Ranked.

methods.name: allowsRematch
methods.comment: Rematch dual-accept stays PRIVATE|CASUAL only (D-99) — Ranked uses Find Ranked match later.

methods.name: createRankedMatch
methods.comment: RANKED NORMAL table. Same seats/WS/reconnect as casual; no rematch window (D-97, D-99).

methods.name: requireBoundSeat
methods.comment: WR-04: Ranked seats must be bound in DB (fail-closed beyond JWT guest claim).

methods.name: requireStickPullDifficulty
methods.comment: Allowlist EASY|NORMAL|HARD for Stick Pull bot create (ASVS L1).

methods.name: createPrivateMatch
methods.comment: PRIVATE NORMAL table. Turn is JOINER (D-30). Client cannot pick seats or difficulty (D-31). playerScore column = host; botScore column = joiner.

methods.name: createCasualMatch
methods.comment: CASUAL NORMAL Quick Match table. Same seats/WS/reconnect as private (D-69, SESS-02).

methods.name: accruePauseBudget
methods.comment: Accrue grace wall-time into pauseUsedMs; flip pauseBudgetGone when Ranked budget hit (D-102).

methods.name: afterPlayerHalfIfInPlay
methods.comment: After a player throw or forfeit that leaves IN_PLAY, run the bot half via GameEngine.

methods.name: applyPocketedBones
methods.comment: Valid knock-outs leave the table. Saka-out foul zeroes the throw and restores any sohi that left the circle (they stay in bonesLeft).

methods.name: persistLeftoverPoses
methods.comment: Keep in-circle rest poses for the next throw. Saka-out foul puts knocked sohi back on the seed line; pocketed sohi on a legal throw are omitted.

methods.name: requirePrivateTerminal
methods.comment: Rematch eligibility for finished PRIVATE|CASUAL only (D-99). Seat-bound via requireSeat (T-05-04).

methods.name: afterTerminal
methods.comment: Sync COINS/GEMS + profile XP/W/L/soft Elo for every paid human seat inside the settle TX (D-45, D-75). Idempotent on retry.

methods.name: resolveHumanAlchikiStatus
methods.comment: Ranked Alchiki: last successful knock-out wins; if none → DRAW (Glicko 0.5/0.5). Casual/Private keep raw score draw.

methods.name: requireSeat
methods.comment: PRIVATE: host or joiner. BOT: owner player_id. Third guest is 403 (T-03-15).

name: com.nomadgames.session.internal.MatchSessionRegistry$RematchWindow
comment: Heap rematch dual-accept state. {@code MatchService} mutates and reads fields only inside {@code synchronized(this)} so concurrent Again? cannot mint two PRIVATE rows.

name: com.nomadgames.session.internal.ReconnectPolicy
comment: Reconnect grace + Ranked pause budgets (SESS-02/03/04, D-41, D-86, D-101…D-103). Casual Alchiki 30s / Stick Pull 8s; Ranked Alchiki 18s / Stick Pull 12s. Ranked pause budgets Alchiki 45s / Stick Pull 20s; non-Ranked unlimited.

methods.name: graceSeconds
methods.comment: Game-aware grace (Casual / Private): STICK_PULL → 8s, else Alchiki/default 30s (D-86).

methods.name: graceSeconds
methods.comment: Mode+game grace: RANKED Stick 12 / Alchiki 18; else Casual 8 / 30 (D-101).

methods.name: pauseBudgetSeconds
methods.comment: Aggregate pause budget for Ranked (D-102). Non-Ranked returns {@link Integer#MAX_VALUE} so budget forfeit never fires.

methods.name: graceDeadline
methods.comment: @deprecated Prefer {@link #graceDeadline(Instant, String, String)} with mode+game.

methods.name: graceDeadline
methods.comment: @deprecated Prefer {@link #graceDeadline(Instant, String, String)} with mode.

name: com.nomadgames.session.internal.TapRateLimiter
comment: Connection-level Stick Pull tap flood gate (ASVS L1). Soft clamp is 10 TPS; this cuts useless applyTap/DB/broadcast work above ~15 msg/s per seat.

methods.name: reset
methods.comment: Clears all windows — used by ITs so flood cases do not poison later tests.
